items.name: crate_version
items.summary: Returns Rust core version or custom set client_version such as the py-binding

items.name: init_client_version
items.summary: Record the client version reported by `crate_version`.

items.name: open_table
items.signature: async fn open_table(table_url: url::Url) -> Result<DeltaTable, DeltaTableError>
items.summary: Creates and loads a DeltaTable from the given URL with current metadata. Infers the storage backend to use from the scheme in the given table URL.

items.name: open_table_with_ds
items.signature: async fn open_table_with_ds(table_url: url::Url, ds: impl AsRef<str>) -> Result<DeltaTable, DeltaTableError>
items.summary: Creates a DeltaTable from the given URL.

items.name: open_table_with_storage_options
items.signature: async fn open_table_with_storage_options(table_url: url::Url, storage_options: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>) -> Result<DeltaTable, DeltaTableError>
items.summary: Same as `open_table`, but also accepts storage options to aid in building the table for a deduced `StorageService`.

items.name: open_table_with_version
items.signature: async fn open_table_with_version(table_url: url::Url, version: kernel::Version) -> Result<DeltaTable, DeltaTableError>
items.summary: Creates a DeltaTable from the given URL and loads it with the metadata from the given version. Infers the storage backend to use from the scheme in the given table URL.
